footnote_text: On October 9, 2026, in connection with the closing of the Business Combination, (i) each outstanding Class A ordinary share of the Issuer automatically converted into one share of Class A common stock of Pubco, (ii) each outstanding Class B ordinary share of the Issuer automatically converted into one Class A ordinary share of the Issuer, which in turn automatically converted into one share of Class A common stock of Pubco, and (iii) each outstanding warrant of the Issuer automatically converted to one warrant to purchase one share of Class A common stock of Pubco. As a result, Reporting Person no longer beneficially owns any securities of the Issuer.
